name: Herb Search — Recipes tab switches result list

planSteps.description: Type 'tea for relaxation' into the search input and click 'Consult the Archive'
Click the tab button whose text starts with 'Recipes ('
The Recipes tab is active and the page shows either one or more recipe cards (each with a title and an 'ingredients' count) or the text 'No recipes found.'
No herb cards with a '% match' badge are shown while the Recipes tab is active
